FULL TEXT:
NOTIFICATION
Date: 03.03.2025
The university vide its Advertisement No. HBTU/Estt/02/2024 dated 07.12.2024
had invited online Applications in prescribed format for direct recruitment to faculty
positions in various departments of the university. The applications of the candidates
received for the post of Associate Professor and Professor in various branches/departments
have been scrutinized by a duly constituted screening/scrutiny committee and scores
awarded as per the “Assessment Methodology for calculation of API/Research Score for the
post of Associate Professor/Professor” presented in Table C of the “Screening and
Selection Criteria” uploaded on the website along with the Advertisement. Accordingly, as
per the recommendations of the Screening/scrutiny committee, the following tentative “lists
of candidates found eligible/provisionally eligible/not eligible along with their API
score” are being uploaded/displayed on this university website www.hbtu.ac.in. (under
the recruitment link).
Associate Professor
a) Chemical Engineering (OBC)
b) Biochemical Engineering (UR)
c) Food Technology (EWS)
d) Paint Technology (UR)
e) Paint Technology (OBC)
f) Plastic Technology (UR)
g) Humanities- Economics (UR)
Professor
a) Civil Engineering (UR)
b) Electronics Engineering (UR)
c) Chemical Engineering (OBC)
d) Paint Technology (OBC)
e) Chemistry (SC)
f) Mathematics (OBC)
The candidates are advised to go through these lists. The grievances/objections,
if any, may be submitted at Email Id: recruitment2024@hbtu.ac.in by the candidates from
their registered email Id given in the Application Form, till 10.03.2025 (Monday, 07 PM).
The grievance/ objections should be supported by authentic documentary evidence. Any
grievance/ objections received after due date or without any supporting document shall not
be entertained. Candidates are requested to mention clearly their Application id, Name,
Date of Birth, Department and registered mobile No. applied for in the email. All such
candidates whose status is “Provisionally Eligible” must submit the requisite documents by
10.03.2025. Decision of the University shall be final in this regard.
It would be pertinent to mention that all those candidates who are provisionally
eligible shall be subject to verification of documents in original (especially related to
educational qualifications, caste certificate, experience, research papers etc) at the time of
interview, if called for. Those in employment should submit the “No Objection Certificate”
from their present employer at the time of Interview.
Note:
1. The University shall not be responsible for any error/omission/relevant Information by
the applicant knowingly or unknowingly while filling up the application form. In case
the applicant gets Screened/shortlisted/selected/appointed on the basis of the Incorrect
forged/fabricated Credentials furnished by him/her, his/her candidature shall be liable
to be cancelled at any stage of the recruitment/at any time during the tenure of the
service and appropriate legal action under applicable law shall be initiated against the
applicant.
2. The University reserves the right for alteration/modification/correction in the event of
any error.
Registrar
